motion.framework: motion (motion/react bundled) + pure CSS Keyframes for SVG telemetry

patterns.svg_pulse: CSS pulse animation on sensor beacons with ring expansion: opacity 1 -> 0, transform scale(1) -> scale(2.4)
patterns.data_packets: CSS motion path or stroke-dashoffset animation traveling smoothly from sensor nodes to gateway along SVG curved paths every 2.5s
patterns.page_transition: Simple opacity fade-in (0.15s) with subtle 4px Y-translation, no jittery heavy animations
patterns.card_hover: Subtle 2px translateY and soft border highlight (border-slate-300)

motion.accessibility_rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion by falling back to static rings and steady indicators

accessibility.color_contrast: All text tokens provide at least 4.5:1 against their designated surface. Critical alert badges use dark red (#991B1B) on light red (#FEE2E2) (contrast 7.8:1).
accessibility.focus_states: All buttons, inputs, links, and map toggles feature focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F4C81] focus:ring-offset-2
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, map controls, and metric counters MUST contain explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='explore-platform-btn', data-testid='sensor-filter-rainfall', data-testid='kpi-active-sensors')

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts: FastAPI backend (backend/server.py, port 8001) + Vite/React 19 frontend (frontend/src/, port 3000).

Typography: Import '@fontsource-variable/inter' and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans' / '@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono' in frontend/src/index.css. Set --font-sans to 'IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif' and --font-heading to 'Inter Variable, sans-serif'.

Design Tone: Premium Indian Government & Disaster Management Authority portal. Clean, dignified Material UI aesthetic with Deep Government Blue (#0F4C81 / #0B2545), Forest Green (#1B4D3E), Teal (#0D9488), and high-contrast alert badges. NO cyberpunk neon, NO flashy startup gradients, NO dark-mode-only gaming aesthetic.

HERO SECTION VISUALIZATION (Component: EnvironmentalNetworkAnimation.tsx): Build a custom animated SVG representing a Himalayan mountain terrain with 8-10 distributed LoRa sensor nodes (Rainfall, Soil Moisture, Temp, Water Level, Smoke/Fire, Air Quality, Tilt/Landslide), one central LoRaWAN Gateway with antenna tower and radio wave animations, glowing connection lines with moving data packets (CSS dashoffset/stroke-dasharray animation), interactive tooltip inspection for each node, and 4 floating glassmorphic KPI badges.

Map Integration: Install 'leaflet' and '@types/leaflet' in frontend/ via yarn. Use OpenStreetMap tiles with custom styled markers, layer filter panel (Sensors, Rainfall Radar, Landslide Hazard, Fire Risk), popup inspection sheets, and sensor telemetry sidebar.

Full Feature Set Required: 1. Public Landing (Hero, 6-Step Workflow, Layered Tech Architecture, Emergency Contacts, Footer); 2. Auth (Login, Register with Officer Department Selection, Forgot Password); 3. Main Dashboard (KPI Cards, Live Map, Alert Feed, Recharts Telemetry); 4. GIS Full-Screen Monitoring (Layer toggles, Location Drawer); 5. Digital Twin Simulator (Parameter sliders, Run Simulation button, Hazard Zone Predictions); 6. AI Risk Assessment (Multi-Agent consensus gauge, contributing factors, AI recommendation, disclaimer); 7. Alerts Center (Filter by Severity, Acknowledge/Resolve actions); 8. Sensor Network Management (Add sensor, Gateway status, battery/signal levels); 9. Reports & Exports (PDF/CSV download simulation); 10. User Management & 403 Access Restricted Screen.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute for end-to-end test verification.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow 8px Material Design spacing grid: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, gap-4, gap-6.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Do NOT center-align the entire app container or main content. Keep headers, descriptions, and data tables cleanly left-aligned for readability.
Never use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>; use shadcn/ui components provided in frontend/src/components/ui/.
Ensure the app degrades gracefully if the backend is unreachable — always render the UI shell and fallback mock data instead of blank white screens.
